episodes.title: Rebirth
episodes.summary: Brilliant but bored high school student Light Yagami suddenly finds himself holding the power of life and death in his hands.

episodes.title: Confrontation
episodes.summary: While the world's criminals continue to drop dead, L meets by computer with representatives from various nations.

episodes.title: Dealings
episodes.summary: Ryuk, the Shinigami, or god of death, who dropped the Death Note into the human world, warns Light that someone is on his trail.

episodes.title: Pursuit
episodes.summary: Light--now known to the world as Kira--tests the Death Note to understand the scope of its powers by killing off six convicts in various ways...

episodes.title: Tactics
episodes.summary: Soichiro Yagami demands to meet with L in person when he finds out that L has secretly brought FBI agents into Japan.

episodes.title: Unraveling
episodes.summary: Light meets a woman at the Police Department with an urgent message for the Kira task force.

episodes.title: Overcast
episodes.summary: Light uses the Death Note to try to get rid of the woman who could get him captured, and is shocked when it doesn't work.

episodes.title: Glare
episodes.summary: L insists on setting up bugs and cameras in the homes of Chief Yagami and Deputy Director Kitamura...

episodes.title: Encounter
episodes.summary: The murders continue, and L grows suspicious of Light's too-perfect behavior and decides to investigate him on his own.

episodes.title: Doubt
episodes.summary: L's suspicion of Light deepens, compelling him to invite Light into the investigation.

episodes.title: Assault
episodes.summary: As predicted on the tapes sent to Sakura TV, news anchors and commentators who expressed doubt about Kira die one by one.

episodes.title: Love
episodes.summary: With a second Kira now on the loose, L asks Light to join the task force and pose as the real Kira in order to catch the copycat.

episodes.title: Confession
episodes.summary: Light goes to Aoyama to discover the identity of the second Kira before L becomes more suspicious.

episodes.title: Friend
episodes.summary: Light and Misa show each other their Death Notes, and Light asks Misa to have her shinigami Rem get rid of L.

episodes.title: Wager
episodes.summary: Evidence turns up that points to Misa Amane as the second Kira.

episodes.title: Decision
episodes.summary: Misa is in confinement, though her memories of the Death Note have been completely wiped away.

episodes.title: Execution
episodes.summary: After fifty days of confinement the killings continue, and Misa and Light are released.

episodes.title: Ally
episodes.summary: Though L is still suspicious, Light and Misa, their memories of being Kira wiped clean, return to headquarters...

episodes.title: Matsuda
episodes.summary: Matsuda, the task force member assigned to watch Misa, is eager to distinguish himself...

episodes.title: Makeshift
episodes.summary: L's team discovers that the Yotsuba Group meet in secret to discuss the elimination of individuals who are troublesome to their company...

episodes.title: Performance
episodes.summary: The Yotsuba Group hires Eraldo Coil to uncover L's identity.

episodes.title: Guidance
episodes.summary: Misa succeeds in narrowing down the Kira suspects in the Yotsuba Group to one: Higuchi.

episodes.title: Frenzy
episodes.summary: Higuchi of the Yotsuba Group attempts to kill Matsuda of the task force, and is surprised when he doesn't die after 40 seconds.

episodes.title: Revival
episodes.summary: Higuchi is captured and tells the investigators about the Death Note.

episodes.title: Silence
episodes.summary: Light, his memory recovered, orders Misa to begin killing after Higuchi dies.

episodes.title: Renewal
episodes.summary: Light has removed everyone in his way and is closer to achieving his perfect world.

episodes.title: Abduction
episodes.summary: A new investigator steps forward--Near, a central figure in the SPK, an organization that is trying to catch Kira without relying on L.

episodes.title: Impatience
episodes.summary: Light, acting as L, reveals to Near that his sister Sayu has been kidnapped by someone wanting to trade her for the Death Note.

episodes.title: Father
episodes.summary: Light tries to discover where Mello and his Mafia associates are hiding and uses Misa's eyes to find the Death Note's current owner.

episodes.title: Justice
episodes.summary: Mello busts into SPK headquarters to retrieve a photograph of himself to make sure he won't be killed by Kira.

episodes.title: Transfer
episodes.summary: Near contacts the Japanese task force and determines that Kira is among their members.

episodes.title: Selection
episodes.summary: Star newscaster Kiyomi Takada becomes Kira's spokesperson to the world...

episodes.title: Scorn
episodes.summary: Light pretends to investigate Kiyomi...

episodes.title: Vigilance
episodes.summary: Aizawa figures out what's going on and tells Near, who already knows about the notes.

episodes.title: Malice
episodes.summary: Light gives Kiyomi the order to finish off Near.
Near, along with the SPK, meets Light and the task force at a warehouse for the final showdown.

episodes.title: New World
episodes.summary: Though Mikami has written all the investigators' names in the Death Note, 40 seconds pass and everyone is still alive.
